A hilltop iron-ring fortress of concentric ditches and timber walls banded with black iron, each ring packed with war-machines, the summit crowned with a crude iron tower and massive war-drum.
A quarry-fortress cut straight down into grey rock, walls formed by the quarry face itself, iron staples and crude ladders connecting levels, the floor packed with orcs, forges, and caged war-beasts.

A steppe war-column camp stretching for miles along a trampled road, wheeled siege-towers rolling at its center, outriders circling like carrion birds, the sheer scale of the column darkening the horizon.

A coastal cliff-hold of black basalt, crude iron cannon-stumps bristling from its sea-face, ships burning in the water below, orc warriors hauling plunder up rope-ladders to the thundering fortress above.

A ruined city taken and remade, streets barricaded with iron scrap and bone-lashed timber, towers capped with skull-cairns, forge-smoke rising from every captured building, the entire district one savage sprawling war-hold.
A sprawling war-camp on a burnt plain, hide tents and bone totems crowding roaring fire-pits, crude siege-engines hulking in the ash-choked smoke like iron beasts.
A mountain stronghold of black stone and rough timber, smelting-pits glowing orange in its flanks, war-drums thundering over the mud-churned ground below.
A smelting-pit warren dug deep into a hillside, orange molten light bleeding from every crude shaft, smoke-blackened orcs hauling iron slabs up mud-slicked ramps in the gloom.
A palisade horde-camp ringed with sharpened stakes crowned by severed heads, thousands of hide tents packed within, the ground churned black mud beneath countless iron-shod boots.
A captured ruined castle crudely re-fortified with iron plates and timber bracing, skull-poles jammed into every battlement, crude war-banners draping the ancient crumbling stone walls.
A volcanic war-forge built into the flank of an active mountain, rivers of lava channeled beneath crude iron grates, weapon-racks and bellowing furnaces filling every black-walled chamber.
A bone-and-timber stockade sprawling over a muddy war-ground, vast skull-pyramids at each corner, smoke rising from ten thousand cook-fires inside the thick hide-lashed timber walls.
A cliff-fortress of black towers carved from raw stone, iron chains spanning the gorge below, war-banners snapping in the bitter wind above a horde packed onto the ledges.
A siege-camp before a crumbling wall, a city of crude tents and iron war-machines stretching back across the scorched plain, battering rams draped in iron and bristling with bone.
A river-delta war-hold of timber and iron, crude bridges lashing together muddy islands, bone-hung watchtowers rising from the black water, war-drums echoing across the stinking marsh.
A sprawling underground orc-hold beneath a dead forest, crude iron pillars holding a low stone ceiling, forge-fires and weapon-racks filling the vast smoky dark below the ruined earth.
A desert iron-fortress half-buried in red sand, its crude black towers jutting from the dunes, war-banners bleached by sun and ash, the horde camped in its scorched shadow.
A war-barge fortress moored in a black lake, iron-plated decks crowded with catapults and bone totems, skull-prows jutting from every lashed timber hull, smoke pouring from forge-holes below decks.
A tundra war-hold of black stone and mammoth bone, massive iron-bound gates facing the frozen plain, forges burning day and night to keep the iron-working orcs from freezing.
A canyon-floor stronghold hemmed by red cliffs, crude iron towers bolted directly to the rock face, the narrow ground below packed with tents and war-engine yards belching smoke.
A slag-heap fortress risen from a ruined mine, crude iron walls built from smelter waste, molten runoff cutting orange channels through the black earth below the smoke-choked battlements.
A coastal war-hold of black timber and salvaged iron, crude jetties crowded with war-galleys, skull-poles lining the shore, the hilltop keep smothered in forge-smoke and war-drum thunder.
A jungle war-stockade of crude iron and hacked timber, massive trees stripped and jammed into the earth as walls, bone-hung platforms above the canopy, fire-pits burning in the dark below.
A hilltop iron-ring fortress, crude concentric walls of black stone and timber dropping in brutal tiers to the scorched plain, the horde drilling in the vast muddy ground between the rings.
A sunken swamp-hold built on crude timber piles over black water, iron walkways connecting vast hide-tent platforms, catapult towers rising from the murk, skull-banners trailing in the fetid fog.
A captured dwarven vault ripped open and re-forged as an orc war-hold, ancient stone corridors packed with crude weapon-racks, forge-fires burning in grand carved halls now black with soot.
A frozen-pass stronghold of black iron and rough stone, brutal towers flanking a narrow mountain road, iron chains strung across the gap, a horde packed into crude barracks cut from the rock.

A plain-spanning war-encampment of ten thousand tents, bone-and-iron totems marking the perimeter, crude earthworks and ditch-lines radiating outward, war-machines ranked in vast iron rows across the burnt ground.
A collapsed volcano caldera converted to a massive war-hold, crude iron scaffolding descending the inner walls, forge-pits on every ledge, a horde swarming the black rock like iron-clad ants.

Grothkaar's Iron Maw — a black-iron gate-fortress choking the valley pass, forge-smoke billowing from crude smelting towers, skull-racks lining the walls, a vast horde churning the scorched earth below like a living tide of iron and fury.
